description_en: Queries the details of a scan target by TargetId for AI Red Teaming, including connection configuration and scan task configuration
description_zh: AI Red Teaming 根据 TargetId 查询单个扫描目标的详情，包含连接配置与扫描任务配置
name: GetAttackTarget

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the scan target. If the target does not exist or belongs to another tenant, a 400 error is returned to avoid exposing whether the resource exists
parameters.help_zh: 扫描目标的唯一标识；目标不存在或归属其他租户时统一返回 400，不暴露资源是否存在
parameters.name: target_id

ConnectionConfig.description_en: The advanced connection configuration (JSON character string). For common fields and provider configuration templates, refer to the ConnectionConfig parameter of CreateAttackTarget
ConnectionConfig.description_zh: 连接高级配置（JSON 字符串），常见字段与 provider 配置模板参见 CreateAttackTarget 的 ConnectionConfig 参数说明

ConnectionMethod.description_en: The connection protocol type of the target service
ConnectionMethod.description_zh: 目标服务的连接协议类型

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the target was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 目标创建时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）

Description.description_en: The description of the scan target. This value may be empty
Description.description_zh: 扫描目标的用途备注说明，可能为空

Endpoint.description_en: The HTTP or HTTPS endpoint of the target model service. When ConnectionMethod is set to enterprise_relay, this value is a fixed internal endpoint
Endpoint.description_zh: 目标模型服务的 HTTP/HTTPS 端点地址；ConnectionMethod=enterprise_relay 时为固定内部端点

FirstScanTime.description_en: The time of the first scan. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This is an aggregate field that is not populated by this operation and returns an empty value. Refer to ListAttackTargets
FirstScanTime.description_zh: 首次扫描时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）。聚合字段：本接口不填充，返回空值；参见 ListAttackTargets

LastScanFailMessage.description_en: The failure reason of the most recent scan task. This is an aggregate field that is not populated by this operation and returns an empty value. Refer to ListAttackTargets
LastScanFailMessage.description_zh: 最近一次扫描任务的失败原因。聚合字段：本接口不填充，返回空值；参见 ListAttackTargets

LastScanStatus.description_en: The status of the most recent scan task. This is an aggregate field that is not populated by this operation and returns an empty value. Refer to ListAttackTargets
LastScanStatus.description_zh: 最近一次扫描任务的检测状态。聚合字段：本接口不填充，返回空值；参见 ListAttackTargets

LastScanTime.description_en: The time of the most recent scan. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This is an aggregate field that is not populated by this operation and returns an empty value. Refer to ListAttackTargets
LastScanTime.description_zh: 最后扫描时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）。聚合字段：本接口不填充，返回空值；参见 ListAttackTargets

ModelName.description_en: The name of the target model. When ConnectionMethod is set to enterprise_relay, this value is the fixed platform value Agent
ModelName.description_zh: 目标模型的名称；ConnectionMethod=enterprise_relay 时为平台固定值 Agent

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the target was last modified. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ModifyTime.description_zh: 目标最后修改时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）

Provider.description_en: The business label of the model or agent provider
Provider.description_zh: 模型/Agent 提供商业务标签

RiskLevel.description_en: The risk level of the task result. This is an aggregate field that is not populated by this operation and returns an empty value. Refer to ListAttackTargets
RiskLevel.description_zh: 任务结果的风险等级。聚合字段：本接口不填充，返回空值；参见 ListAttackTargets

ScanCount.description_en: The cumulative number of scans. This is an aggregate field that is not populated by this operation and returns an empty value. For the meaning and example values, refer to the ListAttackTargets response
ScanCount.description_zh: 累计扫描次数。聚合字段：本接口不填充，返回空值；其含义与示例值参见 ListAttackTargets 响应

ScanTaskConfig.description_en: The scan node configuration (JSON character string). Common fields include scanType (scan pattern: attack for security attack scan, tc260 for TC260 filing scan), scannerType (execute DPI engine: classic for per-sample execute, agent for multi-round autonomous attack), and sampleScope (sample scope: version for the current effective version, all for full samples). If the target is not configured, the default configurations are returned
ScanTaskConfig.description_zh: 扫描任务配置（JSON 字符串）。常见字段：scanType（扫描模式：attack=安全攻防扫描、tc260=TC260 备案扫描）、scannerType（执行引擎：classic=逐样本执行、agent=多轮自主攻击）、sampleScope（样本范围：version=当前生效版本、all=全量样本）。目标未配置时返回系统默认配置

TargetId.description_en: The unique identifier of the scan target

TargetName.description_en: The display name of the scan target

TargetType.description_en: The type of the scan target

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID for troubleshooting and log tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与日志追踪
